## AccrualPosition.ltv property

This position's Loan-To-Value (debt over collateral power, scaled by WAD). If the collateral price is 0, LTV is `MaxUint256`<!-- -->. `undefined` if the market's oracle is undefined or reverts.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get ltv(): bigint | null | undefined;
```
